name: Fontelico
about: Fontelico is a free, open-source icon set with 34 icons designed by Fontello. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC BY SA.

faqs.a: Yes. All 34 Fontelico are open source under the CC BY SA license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC BY SA terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Fontelico in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.
There are 34 icons in the Fontelico set, designed by Fontello. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Fontelico?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Fontelico available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
